result.summary: Found 3 visual issues: incorrect bottom-nav active state showing Profile instead of Home, popular content clipped behind the tab bar, and carousel truncation at the right edge.

issues.description: Bottom navigation shows Profile as active (green) while the screen displays the Home feed content
issues.suggestion: Set Home tab as active/selected when on home feed and Profile as inactive to reflect correct navigation state

issues.description: Second card in Popular right now (pizza image) runs directly into the bottom tab bar with no spacing, hiding its restaurant name, metadata and rating
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content padding and safe-area inset so scrollable content ends above the fixed tab bar and is fully readable

issues.description: Third card in Fastest near you is cut off mid-image and mid-text showing 'Trattoria Piccol' without ellipsis or end padding
issues.suggestion: Add horizontal list end-padding and ensure truncated titles use ellipsis rather than mid-word clipping
